• Durg–Raipur–Arang Expressway | Package-A Ground Update 2026*
In this video, we take you on a detailed ground-level journey through *Package-A of the Durg–Raipur–Arang Expressway,* covering the latest construction progress across the entire section.
The Durg–Raipur–Arang Expressway is an important greenfield/access-controlled highway project in Chhattisgarh, designed to improve connectivity between *Durg, Raipur & Arang* & provide a faster route for through traffic.
